annotation.title_clean: Taxonomy and Definitions for Terms Related to Cooperative Driving Automation for On-Road Motor Vehicles (SAE J3216_202107)
annotation.title_en: Taxonomy and Definitions for Terms Related to Cooperative Driving Automation for On-Road Motor Vehicles (SAE J3216_202107)
annotation.summary_en: SAE J3216 (July 2021 revision) is an information report that sets out a taxonomy and definitions for cooperative driving automation. It covers machine-to-machine communication among automated vehicles, other road users and road operators to support the dynamic driving task. Its stated aims are better traffic safety and flow and a common vocabulary for designing and validating CDA. It was superseded by the 2025 revision.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines cooperative driving automation (CDA) as M2M communication supporting the dynamic driving task for vehicles with automation features engaged
Participants include automated vehicles, shared road users and road operators
Information shared can include state, intent, or agreement on a plan such as a coordinated merge
States that driving automation does not require cooperation to be performed safely
Technology-neutral and focused on applications rather than communication protocols; strategic functions like trip scheduling are out of scope
